dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Pronounced narrowing of the 2D planar body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Dark slate-grey skin tone with low median pixel intensity.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High frequency of small, light-toned punctate marks distributed across the central dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the dark grey baseline and light-toned surface marks.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple small light-toned spots on the dorsal plane and a clearly defined dark circular blowhole aperture.
